summary: A quantified Lean construction takes any inhabited, well-founded one-world grounding structure whose edges have distinct existing relata and whose independently specified noninitial members have predecessors, and produces two mutually accessible, disjoint rigid-copy histories preserving those world-local constraints while no individual exists concretely and necessarily. An explicit root-child source satisfies every antecedent with an actual grounding edge. This refutes the attempted inference from these world-local premises alone to de re necessary concrete existence within the stipulated semantics; it does not prove the metaphysical possibility of disjoint worlds or rule out anti-brute/cross-world principles.
blocker: No independent metaphysical justification has yet eliminated contingent grounding roots, established universal contingent existential dependence, or constrained cross-world identity/recombination. These remain separate frontier premises.
